edition: Opera Bebeliana sequentia: Triumphus Veneris [...]. — Pforzheim: Anshelm, 1509.

leaf_check.note: Starts at 'Rurales aluere casae' (page's first line) and ends at 'Oleniae nec me retinet pluviale capellae' (last line before signature 'F ij'); all 29 verse lines present. Running head 'QVINTVS' and signature omitted. Marginal notes (Agasina, Apollonia danubiana, Puellae Tubingenses, Puellae alpestres pulcherrimae) are present but inlined into the verse; two are placed a line or two off from their printed position (Tubingenses inlined before 'Taliter' though printed beside 'Miserat urbs'; alpestres before 'Militiae' though printed beside 'Attamen alpestres'). Heavy abbreviation (q; = que, ã/ũ nasal macrons, ę = ae, & = et) silently expanded and u/v normalised; 'Danubius ... recessit' same. Same page boundaries, so the same edition. Offset: page_number = pb + 1.
